# Marinda Williams – Meydan Leasing

> Marinda Williams is a RERA-licensed leasing and sales specialist at fäm Properties (BRN 93250) covering Meydan and Mohammed Bin Rashid City (MBR City), Dubai, especially The Fields and District 11, where she lives. She is a former property manager with over a decade in South African property. Every tenant she places is AECB credit-screened, and rents are priced from Ejari and Dubai Land Department data. Contact: WhatsApp +971 56 243 2174.

- [Home](https://marindawilliams.github.io/): services, communities covered, background and contact
- [The Fields community guide](https://marindawilliams.github.io/the-fields/): 2026 registered rents and sale prices (source: DXB Interact, 1 Jan – 30 Sep 2026), sub-communities and FAQs

- Services: residential leasing, AECB tenant screening, rental valuation, sales, off-plan sales
